findings.evidence: TauCeti/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:340 provides Subgroup.mul_mul_injective_of_disjoint for precisely u * n * b; Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:257 provides disjoint_map.
findings.fix: Keep the specialization, but derive disjointness by mapping negativePoints_inf_borelSubgroup_eq_bot through conjugation using Subgroup.disjoint_map, then apply Subgroup.mul_mul_injective_of_disjoint and project the resulting pair equality.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/GroupTheory/DoubleCoset/Map.lean:171 and :176 provide image_doubleCoset and mem_doubleCoset_image_iff; Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:324 provides map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le. The repeated image proof occurs in Bruhat/Decomposition.lean:180.
